relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: We conclude that Nav1.7 is essential for axonal propagation in around two-thirds of nociceptive cutaneous C-fiber neurons

relationships.subject: PF-05198007
relationships.evidence_quote: One hundred to three hundred nanomolar PF-05198007 blocked propagation in 63% of C-fiber sensory neurons

key_findings: Axonal Nav1.7 block with PF-05198007 stopped propagation in 63% of C-fiber neurons but only 5% of A-fiber neurons.
About two-thirds of cutaneous nociceptors are blocked by axonal TTX; TTX-resistant ones are often polymodal and capsaicin sensitive.
